info.title: meshy/remesh
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "meshy/remesh", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for Meshy's remesh operation (docs.meshy.ai/en/api/remesh): re-topologise or re-format an existing mesh. Supply exactly one of input_task_id or model_url; Meshy requires no single field, so the only structural narrowing is that an empty body is refused.

convert_format_only.description: If true, only changes the format of the input model file, ignoring other inputs like topology, resize_height, and target_polycount.

input_task_id.description: The ID of the completed Image to 3D or Text to 3D task you wish to remesh. Required if model_url is not provided.

model_url.description: A publicly accessible URL or data URI to a 3D model. Supported formats glb, gltf, obj, fbx, stl. Required if input_task_id is not provided.

resize_height.description: Resize the model to a certain height measured in meters. 0 means no resizing.

target_formats.description: A list of target formats for the remeshed model.

target_polycount.description: Specify the target number of polygons in the generated model. Valid range is 100 to 300,000.

200.description: OK - the provider's native result document, returned unchanged. Comfy has not described this model's output yet, so neither its shape nor its media type is narrowed here; the provider's own documentation is authoritative.

schema.description: Comfy has not described this model's result document yet. Router returns the provider's native output unchanged, so the provider's own documentation is authoritative for the response shape.

MeshyTopology.description: Specify the topology of the generated model.
